name: Split Shell
description: Two facing shell portraits, a bowed double frame and a generous centred reading column.

name: Pistachio Study
description: An asymmetric specimen page with an almond-shaped portrait, a tall side rule and a sweeping serif heading.

name: Walnut Intaglio
description: An engraved walnut line drawing on an open literary page, with nested contour borders and a quiet inset text column.

name: Hazel Cabinet
description: A cabinet of paired arched portraits beneath a tabbed heading, followed by a broad writing drawer and inlaid handles.

name: Cashew Current
description: A rounded horizontal portrait and an offset heading follow a fine cashew curve down an open page.

name: Kernel Call
description: A softly ribbed smartphone with a circular contact portrait, pill camera and roomy incoming message bubbles.

name: Shell Flip
description: A vertical clamshell handset with a portrait cover screen, coloured hinge, separate message screen and tactile keypad.

name: Grove Link
description: A landscape handheld messenger with twin contact capsules, recessed chat screen and side-mounted circular controls.

name: Peanote
description: A compact wide pager with a segmented time display, LCD-like conversation pane and three oval hardware keys.

name: Cob OS
description: A narrow smartphone with a curved wallpaper strip, round contact portrait, outlined chat bubbles and a low home bar.

name: Nutlet
description: A small tapered note with an almond seal, a left inset title and a curved coloured foot.

name: Almond Kiss
description: An almond-cut portrait beside a short serif title and a compact reply with a delicate horizontal rule.

name: Twin Kernels
description: Two overlapping oval portraits sit on a single slender capsule above a centred miniature reply.

name: Cupule
description: A small bowl-shaped note with layered curved borders, tiny nut scoring and a right-aligned signature.

name: Bract
description: An off-centre portrait tab sits inside a botanical bracket beside a brief reply and a narrow vertical heading.
